verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents an approval gate on task contracts and automated product reviews on pull requests. Those are reviews of individual work items and code changes, not versioning, review, or rollback of the automations themselves (skills, agent cadences, task definitions). No evidence shows version history or rollback for any Foreloop automation; code-level history comes from GitHub, the host platform, not Foreloop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
